title: Iran's acting Defense Minister Brig. Gen. Seyyed Majid Ibn Al-Reza says the repetition of past threats by the enemy demonstrates that its intelligence and analytical apparatus has become paralyzed.
text: Iran's acting Defense Minister Brig. Gen. Seyyed Majid Ibn Al-Reza says the repetition of past threats by the enemy demonstrates that its intelligence and analytical apparatus has become paralyzed.
